title: About Us
description:
We are a student team from the Polytechnic University of Turin, formed by students with diverse backgrounds and degrees. Led by Professor Giuseppe Quaglia, the team has three main goals:
+ to train students, enabling them to enhance their practical technical skills;
+ to develop socially impactful robots;
+ to participate in promotional and disclosure events within the robotics field.
The team's primary focus lies in the development of innovative and efficient robots for Search and Rescue (SAR) activities to contribute to the advancement of technology in life-saving operations.

areas.title: Our Areas
areas.description:
We are a multidisciplinary team where stusdents from different backgrounds collaborate for a common purpose, which generally involves building robots.
In the projects we handle, there are many aspects to consider, from physical parts to software and logical control, not to mention non-technical areas like communication.
Discover in detail the various areas of the team!

items.title: SOFTWARE
items.description: We develop Python code for ROS to manage the robot's high-level software. We are responsible for developing the team's website using technologies such as React, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. We use DevOps tools to facilitate software development and deployment, such as Docker and GitHub Actions. We manage the lab server and the platforms used by the team, such as Proxmox, OPNsense, and Wireguard.

items.title: MANAGEMENT
items.description: The Management Area is the organizational core of Team ISAAC. It oversees all cross-functional activities essential to the project’s success: managing purchases, building relationships with sponsors and partners, preparing funding proposals, recruiting new members, and planning strategic activities. It is composed of the team leader and the area leaders, who work closely to ensure the team’s efficiency, cohesion, and growth.

items.title: MECHANICS
items.description: We handle both functional and executive design, using SolidWorks for CAD modeling. We use CNC, milling machine, lathe and 3D printing to create parts in polymers and technopolymers. Also, we created and complete assembled by ourselves the robotic platform.

items.title: ELECTRONICS
items.description: We handle the electronic component of the robot, designing electrical schematics and printed circuit boards (PCBs). We also work on the physical production of electronic boards and wiring.

items.title: COMMUNICATION
items.description: We manage our social media, particularly Instagram, and document the team's activities with photos and videos. We handle website management and curate the team's public image, creating custom apparel, posters, flyers, and business cards.
